g.text: Deployment cost components by scale (feasible outputs only)
Source: independent_v1/main_* only; 90 held-out instances (45 small / 30 medium / 15 large). Feasible seed means per instance, then successful instances
equally weighted; n is successful instances. Each stack sums to reported total cost. Backup is already inside compute and is not stacked again. N/F: no
feasible output. Successful subsets differ across algorithms.
